t: You're looking at a statue of Sir Walter Raleigh in the grounds of the Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich. The sculptor was William McMillan, a Scottish artist known for several public statues around the country. The statue originally stood in Whitehall and was moved here in 2002. It is Grade II listed. Raleigh was a leading figure of the Elizabethan era: statesman, soldier, writer and explorer, who helped defend England against the Spanish Armada and played a part in colonising North America.
